notes.title: The big fix!
notes.notes:
This patch fixes all the [b]known[/b] bugs. Some more severe and some just annoying. It also adds autosave pop ups to few places where there's a big risk of a game over.

A lot of balancing has been done to the items and combat. It's still hard, but now it encourages even more the use of [b]skills and items.[/b]

This update is for the [b]Windows version only.[/b] The newer MacOS updates have quite completely destroyed my ability to make anything with the Mac version and it's possible the Mac version can't be supported any further.

notes.title: Small bug fixes and balancing the economy
notes.notes:
- very minor bug fixes
- Now you can't accidentally miss the option for "easy Mode"
- small balancing of skills, items and prices:
 - - - First Aid Guide is more affordable
 - - - Drinks at the bar give better results
 - - - Deep Breath is more useful skill
 - - - Drunk Punch is more unpredictable, but useful skill
 - - - Life Shot is more effective
